factors.oTOV: offensive ball security / turnover avoidance, pts/100
factors.oSC: offensive SECOND-CHANCE value (not raw oREB count), pts/100
factors.dTS: defensive true-shooting conceded, pts/100 (WEAK: no tracking data, OOF R2~0.18)
factors.dSC: defensive second-chance conceded, pts/100 (WEAK: no tracking data, OOF R2~0.15)
factors.net: net rating (currently a separate solve; net:=sum6 pending; RESID peaks ~0.5)

war_note: descriptive accrual; win-slope = phi(HCA/sigma)/sigma ~ 2.27 wins/pt over 82 games; $/win is a market convention, not a model output; ~17% of board names are id-ambiguous and get no WAR
ci_note: CIs are de-shrunk ridge SEs (nominal); system nominal-90% covers ~88%
caveats: net is a separate solve; RESID small (peaks ~0.5)
breakout alerts lag real change ~weeks (700-day half-life)
